_comment: HumanityOS's own tools on the Apps page's green part (2026-10-19, src/gui/pages/apps/own_tools.rs): the app's own pages a person uses, each opening its page in the app. One entry each: its name, its page (the page id src/gui/dispatch.rs page_id gives), and one plain line about it. Dev-only pages (Testing, Dev, the planet tuner) are not listed (a test in own_tools.rs holds this list to the entries). A new tool is a new entry here, never code.

tools.name: Maps
tools.line: Every map in one place, from the solar system down to the ground.

tools.name: Tasks
tools.line: Your own tasks on a board: to do, in progress, done.

tools.name: Inventory
tools.line: What you have, where it is kept, and what you wear.

tools.name: Crafting
tools.line: Recipes, and making things from what you have.

tools.name: Quests
tools.line: Quests in the game, step by step.

tools.name: Home
tools.line: Your homestead: its rooms, what it needs and what it makes.

tools.name: Library
tools.line: The Humanity Accord, guides and the dictionary, to read.

tools.name: How-to
tools.line: Step-by-step how-tos to follow and tick off, for real life and for this app.

tools.name: Calendar
tools.line: A month at a glance, with your events.

tools.name: Calculator
tools.line: A calculator, with scientific functions and a history.

tools.name: Chat
tools.line: Messages with people, groups and servers.

tools.name: Watch
tools.line: Watch the live streams on a server.

tools.name: Files
tools.line: What people share on this server, the app's own folder, and your folders.

tools.name: Market
tools.line: Offer things and find what others offer.

tools.name: Wallet
tools.line: Your wallet: its balance, its address and sending.

tools.name: Browser
tools.line: Websites, read here or opened in your browser.
